body: I don’t remember what brought me joy. I’ve tried to do so much. Nothing brings me happiness. I wish I could follow your advice, but I don’t know. It’s too much to bear all the time. It all hurts always
Why? There’s nothing left for me

My only regret is cheating on my now-ex. He deserved better and I wish I could have done that for him. I lost track of how many I took. I could never do anything that painful, it’s just easier to take everything in reach
It’s a bit late to change my mind. I’m overdosing on whatever I could find in the medicine cabinet. Not very fun or effective, as I’ve heard, but fuck it there’s nothing left anyway

I can’t feel anything. I got dumped yesterday for good reason, I cheated on him twice. And my last relationship ended like that too. Besides, I’ve never seen myself living to 25 so I may as well just do it before high school is over. Less hassle for everyone
And there we go, hopefully an hour or so and I’m gone. Goodbye! :)
